lead.zh: APEC闭幕、三国和平宣言公布；Anthropic上市难解AI担忧，亚股重挫；国际法院裁定缅甸犯种族灭绝罪。
lead.en: APEC closes with a trilateral declaration; Anthropic's debut fails to calm AI fears as Asian stocks plunge; the ICJ finds Myanmar guilty of genocide.

title.zh: 英伟达停止向中国发货H200芯片，黄仁勋表态愿回归
title.en: Nvidia stops shipping H200s to China; Huang says he would return as CEO

summary.zh: 英伟达临时CEO克雷斯在财报电话会上表示，尽管获美方许可，公司已不再向中国发运H200等Hopper数据中心芯片，指引也不含中国数据中心收入。
summary.en: Interim CEO Colette Kress said Nvidia is no longer shipping licensed Hopper data-center chips such as the H200 to China, and its guidance now excludes them.

body.zh:
据AIBriefs与The Neuron汇总，英伟达上季度在华销售此类芯片约24亿美元；报道称约60万颗H200因北京未批准进口而滞留香港。英伟达第四财季营收指引约1300亿美元，明确不假设任何来自中国的数据中心计算收入。

另据AIBriefs，上周被董事会罢免的黄仁勋表示，若董事会同意愿重新出任CEO，但董事会在周二的财报电话会上已拒绝这一设想。同时，一个国会委员会就中国军方对英伟达芯片的兴趣发出警告，英伟达也提醒客户向中国企业出租云算力可能存在法律风险。
body.en:
Nvidia sold about $2.4 billion of those chips in China last quarter, and roughly 600,000 H200s were reportedly stuck in Hong Kong after Beijing withheld import approval, according to [AIBriefs](https://aibriefs.news/briefing/2026-11-19). Nvidia's fiscal Q4 outlook of about $130 billion assumes no China data-center compute revenue.

Jensen Huang, ousted last week, said he would return as CEO if the board agreed; the board rejected the idea on Tuesday's earnings call. Separately, a congressional commission warned about Chinese military interest in Nvidia chips, and Nvidia cautioned customers about legal risks in renting cloud capacity to Chinese firms ([The Neuron](https://www.theneuron.ai/digest/everything-that-happened-in-ai-today-thursday-november-19-2026/)).

title.zh: 腾讯开源Hy4 flash：2240亿参数多模态MoE模型，支持百万上下文
title.en: Tencent open-weights Hy4 flash, a 224B multimodal MoE model with 1M context

summary.zh: 腾讯发布并开源混元Hy4 flash，总参数约2240亿、每token激活120亿，支持100万token上下文和图像输入，API定价每百万输入0.07美元。
summary.en: Tencent released open weights for Hy4 flash: about 224B parameters with 12B active, a 1M-token context and image input, priced at $0.07 per million input tokens via API.

body.zh:
据AIBriefs，Hy4 flash推理速度约每秒200 token，腾讯称首日处理超过50万亿token，创混元模型首日用量纪录；API输出价格为每百万token 0.3美元。

权重（BF16指令版、FP8版和base版）已上架Hugging Face、ModelScope和GitCode，采用Tencent Hy License 1.0，允许商用，但超大型MaaS服务商需另行授权。
body.en:
Per [AIBriefs](https://aibriefs.news/briefing/2026-11-19), Hy4 flash runs at roughly 200 tokens per second; Tencent says it processed over 50 trillion tokens on day one, its best Hunyuan first-day usage. Output is priced at $0.3 per million tokens.

The BF16 instruct, FP8 and base weights are on Hugging Face, ModelScope and GitCode under the Tencent Hy License 1.0, which permits commercial use but requires a separate license for very large MaaS providers.

title.zh: 报道：苹果正研发自主AI智能体，对标OpenAI与Anthropic
title.en: Report: Apple is building an autonomous AI agent to rival OpenAI and Anthropic

summary.zh: 据金十数据隔夜要闻汇总，苹果正在研发能自主执行任务的AI智能体，以与OpenAI和Anthropic的同类产品竞争。目前尚无官方细节。
summary.en: Apple is developing an autonomous AI agent to compete with OpenAI and Anthropic, according to Jin10's overnight news roundup. No official details have been released.

title.zh: APEC深圳峰会闭幕，通过《深圳展望》
title.en: APEC summit closes in Shenzhen with the 'Shenzhen Outlook'

summary.zh: 21个APEC成员经济体领导人通过《2026年APEC领导人深圳展望》，承诺加强供应链韧性、能源安全，推进亚太自贸区（FTAAP）和贸易数字化。
summary.en: Leaders of the 21 APEC economies adopted the 2026 Shenzhen Outlook, pledging resilient supply chains, energy security, progress toward an FTAAP and trade digitalization.

body.zh:
据《南华早报》，声明特别强调基本商品供应链韧性，以及确保“不间断、可靠、可负担和可持续”的能源获取。习近平在主持会议时呼吁深化区域经济一体化，称亚太合作“不能开倒车”。

外长王毅在深夜记者会上称《深圳展望》是APEC历史上“最具分量的成果”，为推进亚太自贸区搭建了“四梁八柱”。会议还通过了贸易数字化框架，并就人工智能治理、数字基础设施、清洁能源及粮食和能源安全达成务实举措（据《英文虎报》）。
body.en:
According to the [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/economy/global-economy/article/3375120/apec-leaders-agree-joint-statement-pledges-boost-trade-supply-chain-resilience), the statement stresses supply-chain resilience for essential goods and "uninterrupted, reliable, affordable and sustainable access to energy." Xi, chairing the meeting, said Asia-Pacific cooperation must not turn backward.

Foreign Minister Wang Yi called the Outlook the most consequential achievement in APEC's history. Members also adopted a trade-digitalization framework and measures on AI governance, digital infrastructure, clean energy, and food and energy security ([The Standard](https://www.thestandard.com.hk/china/article/349061/Chinese-Foreign-Minister-hails-Shenzhen-Outlook-as-milestone-as-APEC-summit-concludes)).

title.zh: 中俄美元首“和平宣言”公布：重申核战争打不赢，未提乌克兰和伊朗
title.en: US-China-Russia 'peace declaration' released: no nuclear war, but silence on Ukraine and Iran

summary.zh: 三方会晤后发布的宣言重申“核战争打不赢也打不得”，提出改革联合国、增加精炼油品供应等优先事项，但未提及乌克兰和伊朗战事。
summary.en: The declaration after the three-way summit affirms that a nuclear war cannot be won and must not be fought and lists UN reform and more refined-oil supply, but does not mention Ukraine or Iran.

body.zh:
昨日报道三方会晤“未宣布具体成果”，随后宣言文本公布。据《卫报》，会晤持续一个多小时，涉及核武器、乌克兰战争和国际安全；宣言列出改革联合国、增加石油供应、国际刑事法院管辖权和保护外交豁免等优先事项，但没有提出任何无核化框架。

据金十数据，三国计划增加精炼石油产品的生产和供应。
body.en:
Yesterday the summit was reported without concrete outcomes; the declaration text followed. According to [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/19/apec-summit-trump-xi-putin-meeting-shenzhen-china), the meeting ran more than an hour and covered nuclear weapons, Ukraine and wider security. The declaration's priorities include changing the UN, boosting oil supplies, ICC jurisdiction and protecting diplomatic immunity, but it offers no framework for denuclearisation.

Jin10 reports the three countries plan to raise production and supply of refined oil products.

title.zh: 克里米亚大桥第三次遇袭，普京誓言报复并放弃海上停火
title.en: Putin vows painful response after third Kerch bridge strike, drops sea truce

summary.zh: 乌克兰本周第三次袭击克里米亚大桥后，普京表示俄方将作出“痛苦得多”的回应，不再考虑海上和能源设施停火。
summary.en: After Ukraine struck the Kerch bridge for a third time this week, Putin said Russia would respond far more painfully and would no longer consider a sea or energy-infrastructure truce.

title.zh: 胡塞武装袭击利雅得最高建筑沙特主权基金大厦
title.en: Houthi strike damages Saudi wealth fund's tower, Riyadh's tallest

summary.zh: 沙特民防部门称，胡塞武装19日袭击利雅得阿卜杜拉国王金融区的公共投资基金（PIF）大厦，多层受损，周边建筑也受波及，无人员伤亡。
summary.en: Saudi civil defence said a Houthi attack on Thursday damaged the PIF tower in Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District and nearby buildings, with no casualties.

title.zh: Anthropic上市首日收涨17%，史上最大IPO
title.en: Anthropic closes up 17% in debut after the biggest IPO on record

summary.zh: Anthropic以代码ANT在纳斯达克上市，开盘111.50美元，收于97.17美元，较83美元发行价涨约17%，完全稀释市值约1.8万亿美元。
summary.en: Anthropic opened at $111.50 on Nasdaq under ANT and closed at $97.17, up about 17% from its $83 IPO price, for a fully diluted value of about $1.8 trillion.

body.zh:
据CNBC，Anthropic以每股83美元出售9.8亿股，募资813亿美元，超过SpaceX 6月的上市规模，成为史上最大IPO。首日成交逾8.46亿股，盘中一度令其估值突破2万亿美元。

按完全稀释股本计，收盘市值约1.8万亿美元，位列美国第七大公司；按流通股计约1.3万亿美元。据金十数据，明晟与富时罗素均已宣布将Anthropic纳入相关指数。
body.en:
Anthropic sold 980 million shares at $83 to raise $81.3 billion, topping SpaceX's June debut as the largest IPO ever ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/19/anthropic-ipo-ant-live-updates.html)). More than 846 million shares traded, and the stock briefly valued the company above $2 trillion.

At the close it was worth about $1.8 trillion fully diluted, the seventh most valuable US company, or about $1.3 trillion on outstanding shares. MSCI and FTSE Russell both said they would add it to their indexes, per Jin10.

title.zh: 美股重挫逾2%，道指半年来首次跌破5万点
title.en: US stocks tumble over 2%; Dow closes below 50,000 for first time since June

summary.zh: 道指跌1101点（2.19%）至49097点，标普500跌2.02%，纳指跌2.25%。股指在Anthropic开始交易时跌至盘中低点，AMD遭做空跌7.7%。
summary.en: The Dow fell 1,101 points (2.19%) to 49,097, the S&P 500 lost 2.02% and the Nasdaq 2.25%. Indexes hit session lows as Anthropic began trading; AMD sank 7.7% on a short report.

body.zh:
据CNBC，纳指早盘一度上涨2%，但在Anthropic开始交易那一刻跌至日内低点，投资者在这一AI标志性时刻获利了结。Hunterbrook Capital披露做空AMD并指其涉嫌违反对华出口管制，AMD收跌7.72%。英伟达跌3.3%至145.98美元。

据金十数据，现货黄金跌超2.5%，白银跌约5%。芝加哥联储主席古尔斯比称在高通胀下“所有选项都在考虑范围内”，不排除大幅加息。
body.en:
The Nasdaq was up as much as 2% early but hit its low the moment Anthropic began trading, as investors took profits ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/18/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)). AMD closed down 7.72% after Hunterbrook Capital disclosed a short citing alleged China export-control breaches; Nvidia fell 3.3% to $145.98.

Spot gold fell more than 2.5% and silver about 5%, per Jin10, and Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said all options, including a large hike, are on the table given high inflation.

title.zh: 阿里巴巴季度营收2715亿元增10%，AI云收入增53%
title.en: Alibaba revenue up 10% to RMB271.5bn; AI cloud revenue up 53%

summary.zh: 阿里巴巴截至9月30日的季度营收2715.19亿元，同比增长10%；“AI云与算力服务”分部收入609.73亿元，增长53%，外部客户收入增长64%。
summary.en: Alibaba's September-quarter revenue rose 10% to RMB271.52 billion; its AI cloud and compute segment grew 53% to RMB60.97 billion, with external-customer revenue up 64%.

body.zh:
云智能业务已并入“AI云与算力服务”分部。该分部外部经常性收入增长67%，调整后EBITA增长121%，利润率14.5%。

据每经网，88VIP会员增至约6600万，闲鱼日活同比增长23%。智东西报道称，阿里净利润大涨213%，CEO吴泳铭披露AI相关年化收入已突破700亿元。
body.en:
Cloud Intelligence is now reported inside the AI cloud and compute segment, whose external recurring revenue grew 67% while adjusted EBITA rose 121% to a 14.5% margin.

Per NBD, 88VIP membership reached about 66 million and Xianyu daily active users rose 23%. Zhidx reports net profit jumped 213% and CEO Eddie Wu said AI-related annualized revenue has topped RMB70 billion.

title.zh: 中美同意制定“建设性战略稳定关系行动计划”
title.en: China and US agree to draw up an action plan for 'constructive strategic stability'

summary.zh: 据外交部，习近平与特朗普深圳会晤后，双方同意制定行动计划，落实元首共识，构建基于尊重、公平、对等的中美建设性战略稳定关系。
summary.en: After Xi and Trump met in Shenzhen, China's foreign ministry said both sides agreed to draft an action plan to build constructive, strategically stable ties based on respect, fairness and reciprocity.

body.zh:
双方认为此次会晤积极、有建设性。习近平强调中美要拉长合作清单、压缩问题清单，一时解决不了的分歧要建设性管控，防止矛盾升级；他还就大国如何正确相处提出四点看法（据金十数据汇总）。

据金十数据，特朗普将于北京时间11月21日凌晨1时在白宫举行新闻发布会。
body.en:
Both sides called the meeting positive and constructive. Xi said the two countries should lengthen the list of cooperation, shorten the list of problems, and manage unresolved differences constructively to prevent escalation; he also set out four views on how major powers should get along (per Jin10).

Trump is due to hold a White House news conference at 1 a.m. Beijing time on November 21, Jin10 reports.

title.zh: 人社部修改职称评审规定，2027年1月1日起施行
title.en: China revises professional-title evaluation rules, effective January 1, 2027

summary.zh: 人社部修改《职称评审管理暂行规定》，修改条文10条、新增5条，聚焦强化评审监管、加强信用管理和优化评审服务。
summary.en: The human resources ministry revised its interim rules on professional-title evaluation, amending 10 articles and adding 5 to tighten oversight, credit management and services.

title.zh: 12306上线“候补兑现”与列车调整通知服务
title.en: China's 12306 rail app adds waitlist-fulfilment and service-change alerts

summary.zh: 自11月20日起，12306App新增候补兑现和列车运行调整等系统通知，遇停运、折返、恢复开行、席位调整等情况，旅客将收到提醒。
summary.en: From November 20, the 12306 app sends alerts when waitlisted tickets are fulfilled and when trains are cancelled, turned back, restored or have seat changes.

title.zh: 谷歌推出Mac版Gemini智能体，可直接操作本地应用
title.en: Google brings Gemini computer use to the Mac

summary.zh: 谷歌Mac版Gemini可整理本地文件、填写表单并操作Mac应用，用户可同时继续工作；首批面向美国英语用户中的AI Plus、Pro和Ultra订阅者。
summary.en: Gemini for Mac can organize local files, fill in forms and operate Mac apps while you keep working; it launches in English for US Google AI Plus, Pro and Ultra subscribers.

body.zh:
据The Neuron，这让“替你操作电脑”的竞争更加激烈：同一天有报道称苹果也在研发可操作应用、浏览网页和写代码的智能体，仍处早期阶段。

另据AI Pro Playbook，谷歌同日发布Gemini 4系列第四款模型Gemini 4 Neon，支持100万token上下文，谷歌称其在最高思考档位下位列Artificial Analysis智能指数第三，因用token更少，单任务成本比Gemini 4 Carbon低约三分之一，但按token计价暂不更便宜。
body.en:
Per [The Neuron](https://www.theneuron.ai/digest/everything-that-happened-in-ai-today-friday-november-20-2026/), it sharpens the race for computer-controlling agents: Apple is reportedly building its own agent that operates apps, browses and writes code, though it is at an early stage.

Google also released Gemini 4 Neon, the fourth Gemini 4 model, with a 1M-token context. Google says it ranks third on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its highest thinking setting and costs about a third less per task than Gemini 4 Carbon because it uses fewer tokens, though it is not cheaper per token ([AI Pro Playbook](https://aiproplaybook.com/top-ai-stories/2026-11-19)).

title.zh: 欧盟委员会证实遭AI辅助网络攻击，薪资系统瘫痪逾10天
title.en: European Commission confirms AI-assisted cyberattack that hit payroll systems

summary.zh: 欧盟委员会证实，10月22日发现的一起网络攻击使用了AI工具，人事薪资平台Sysper及医疗报销、翻译服务中断超过10天。
summary.en: The European Commission confirmed that a cyberattack detected on October 22 used an AI tool, disrupting its Sysper HR and payroll platform plus medical-reimbursement and translation services for more than 10 days.

body.zh:
据AP和Euronews，欧盟计算机应急响应小组（CERT-EU）将攻击活动与开源AI渗透测试工具ARTEX关联，但攻击者身份尚未确定。

委员会表示大部分受影响应用已恢复，目前没有证据显示员工数据大规模泄露，也未收到勒索要求；是否有个人信息外泄仍在调查。
body.en:
CERT-EU linked the activity to ARTEX, an open-source AI penetration-testing tool, but attribution is unresolved, according to [AP](https://apnews.com/article/cyberattack-european-union-artificial-intelligence-ai-79705095e8141cd650196dbff1cf3c70) and [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/19/eu-commission-hit-by-large-scale-cyberattack-with-data-leakage-unknown).

The Commission says most affected applications are restored, it has no evidence of a broad staff-data breach and received no ransom demand; whether personal data was taken is still being examined.

title.zh: Meta Muse被曝串混私人对话，员工看到陌生人账户余额
title.en: Meta's Muse reportedly surfaced other people's private data

summary.zh: 据报道，Meta员工使用Muse时看到了不属于自己的育儿消息、个人提醒和银行余额；Meta称员工测试的版本带有公众无法使用的功能。
summary.en: Meta employees reportedly saw unfamiliar childcare messages, personal reminders and bank balances in Muse; Meta said staff test versions with features not available to the public.

title.zh: 国际法院裁定缅甸对罗兴亚人犯下种族灭绝罪
title.en: Top UN court rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya

summary.zh: 国际法院在冈比亚诉缅甸案中裁定，缅甸2017年在若开邦北部“清剿行动”中对罗兴亚人犯下种族灭绝罪，这是该院首次认定一个国家违反《灭种罪公约》。
summary.en: In The Gambia v. Myanmar, the ICJ ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya in its 2017 clearance operations in northern Rakhine, the first time it has found a state guilty under the Genocide Convention.

body.zh:
据国际法院判决摘要，缅甸须调查并起诉责任人、防止类似行为再次发生、恢复流离失所罗兴亚人的返乡与家庭团聚权利，并向受害者赔偿。

赔偿金额和形式将在后续阶段确定；缅甸须在两年内报告其恢复原状计划。
body.en:
Per the [ICJ judgment summary](https://www.refworld.org/sites/default/files/2026-11/178-20261119-pre-01-00-en.pdf), Myanmar must investigate and prosecute those responsible, prevent a repeat, restore displaced Rohingya's rights to return and reunite with family, and compensate victims.

The amount and form of compensation will be set in a later phase, and Myanmar must report its restitution plan within two years.

title.zh: 索马里驱逐阿联酋大使，指其破坏国家主权
title.en: Somalia expels the UAE ambassador, accusing Abu Dhabi of undermining sovereignty

summary.zh: 索马里限阿联酋大使72小时内离境并召回本国驻阿布扎比使节，指责阿联酋通过支持地方政权和港口协议损害索马里主权与统一；阿联酋斥之为“升级和敌对”之举。
summary.en: Somalia gave the UAE ambassador 72 hours to leave and recalled its own envoy, accusing Abu Dhabi of undermining its sovereignty through support for regional authorities and port deals; the UAE called the move escalatory and hostile.

title.zh: 库什纳称俄方接受乌克兰获北约式安全保障，俄副外长：入约“完全不可接受”
title.en: Kushner says Russia accepts NATO-style guarantees for Ukraine; Moscow rules out membership

summary.zh: 40多方在柏林召开“志愿联盟”峰会。库什纳称俄方对战后乌克兰获得类似北约第五条的安全保障感到“满意”；俄副外长里亚布科夫20日则称乌克兰加入北约“完全不可接受”。
summary.en: At a 40-plus-party 'coalition of the willing' summit in Berlin, Kushner said Russia was comfortable with NATO Article 5-style guarantees for postwar Ukraine; Russian deputy FM Ryabkov said on the 20th that NATO membership is completely unacceptable.

body.zh:
据澎湃新闻，峰会由德法英领导人共同主持，与中俄美三方会谈同日举行。特朗普通过电话参会，称普京希望结束战争；据新华社报道，库什纳表示俄罗斯已同意欧洲参加多边谈判机制。

里亚布科夫同时表示，为乌克兰谋求“准成员国”地位或某种“创造性解决方案”，俄方也不会接受。
body.en:
Per [The Paper](https://www.thepaper.cn/expressNews/2026-11-20), the summit was co-chaired by the leaders of Germany, France and Britain on the same day as the China-Russia-US talks. Trump joined by phone and said Putin wants to end the war; Xinhua reported Kushner said Russia had agreed to let Europe join a multilateral negotiating mechanism.

Ryabkov added that Moscow would also reject any 'quasi-member' status or 'creative solution' for Ukraine.

title.zh: 亚股暴跌：台股跌6.2%，日韩跌超5%，AI泡沫担忧加剧
title.en: Asian stocks plunge as AI fears deepen: Taiex down 6.2%, Nikkei and Kospi over 5%

summary.zh: Anthropic上市未能缓解AI泡沫担忧，周五日经225指数跌5.1%，韩国综合指数跌5.2%，台湾加权指数跌6.2%，恒指跌1.9%，上证综指跌1.2%。
summary.en: Anthropic's debut failed to ease AI-bubble fears: on Friday the Nikkei 225 fell 5.1%, the Kospi 5.2%, Taiwan's Taiex 6.2%, the Hang Seng 1.9% and the Shanghai Composite 1.2%.

body.zh:
据共同社，日经指数早盘一度跌至4月以来最低。法国兴业银行亚洲股票策略师阿加瓦尔对半岛电视台表示，市场担心AI驱动的增长正在放缓、“增长高峰期”可能已过；外资不买入的“需求真空”下，本地投资者能撑多久尚待观察，韩国回撤尤为严重。

据路透社（经Investing.com），亚洲股市有望录得2020年以来最差单周表现。
body.en:
Kyodo said the Nikkei briefly hit its lowest since April. Societe Generale strategist Rajat Agarwal told [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/11/20/asias-stock-markets-dive-as-anthropic-debut-fails-to-allay-ai-bubble-fears) the worry is that AI-led growth is slowing and its peak may have passed, and that with foreigners not buying it is unclear how long local investors, especially in Korea, can hold on.

Asian shares are headed for their worst week since 2020, Reuters reported via Investing.com.

title.zh: Anthropic上市第二日盘前一度跌7.4%
title.en: Anthropic falls as much as 7.4% in premarket on its second day

summary.zh: 据彭博，Anthropic周五美股盘前一度下跌7.4%。该股首日盘中较发行价最高涨39%，收盘涨17%，成为全球市值第七大上市公司。
summary.en: Anthropic fell as much as 7.4% in premarket trading on Friday, Bloomberg reported. It had surged as much as 39% from its IPO price on debut before closing up 17%, the world's seventh-largest listed company.

title.zh: 金价重挫，大阪交易所黄金期货8个月来首次熔断
title.en: Osaka gold futures trigger circuit breaker for the first time in 8 months

summary.zh: 受金价大幅下跌影响，大阪交易所黄金期货20日上午10时58分触发熔断，11时08分恢复交易，为今年3月以来首次。
summary.en: Amid a steep drop in gold prices, Osaka Exchange gold futures triggered a circuit breaker at 10:58 a.m. local time on the 20th, resuming at 11:08, the first since March.

title.zh: 习近平会见五国领导人，中国与印尼、新加坡启动贸易谈判
title.en: Xi meets five leaders; China opens trade talks with Indonesia and Singapore

summary.zh: APEC峰会次日，习近平在深圳会见印尼、新加坡、澳大利亚、马来西亚和泰国领导人，与印尼宣布启动全面经济伙伴关系协定谈判，与新加坡启动自贸协定升级谈判。
summary.en: The day after APEC, Xi met the leaders of Indonesia, Singapore, Australia, Malaysia and Thailand in Shenzhen, launching comprehensive economic partnership talks with Indonesia and FTA upgrade talks with Singapore.

body.zh:
据阿纳多卢通讯社援引新华社，习近平呼吁中印尼加强战略沟通，共同防范和应对外部风险。新加坡总理黄循财在X上说，自贸协定升级将涵盖数字经济等新领域，促进跨境数据流动，双方还讨论了人工智能合作。

习近平与澳大利亚总理阿尔巴尼斯同意将2027年定为“中澳旅游年”，阿尔巴尼斯称会谈“富有建设性”。
body.en:
Per [Anadolu](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/chinas-xi-holds-talks-with-regional-leaders-after-apec-trilateral-summit-with-us-russia/4131664), citing Xinhua, Xi urged China and Indonesia to deepen strategic communication and jointly guard against external risks. Singapore's Lawrence Wong said on X the FTA upgrade will cover new areas such as the digital economy and cross-border data flows; the two also discussed AI cooperation.

Xi and Australia's Anthony Albanese agreed to make 2027 the Australia-China Year of Tourism; Albanese called the talks constructive.

title.zh: 11月LPR连续第18个月不变：1年期3%，5年期以上3.5%
title.en: China keeps loan prime rates unchanged for an 18th month

summary.zh: 11月20日，1年期贷款市场报价利率维持3.0%，5年期以上维持3.5%，已连续18个月保持不变。
summary.en: On November 20 China held the one-year loan prime rate at 3.0% and the five-year rate at 3.5%, unchanged for an 18th straight month.

title.zh: 前10月全国一般公共预算收入19.57万亿元，增长4.9%
title.en: China's Jan-Oct budget revenue rises 4.9% to RMB19.57 trillion

summary.zh: 财政部数据显示，1—10月全国一般公共预算收入195671亿元，同比增长4.9%；其中税收收入162622亿元，增长6%，非税收入下降0.2%。
summary.en: Finance ministry data show general public budget revenue of RMB19.567 trillion in January-October, up 4.9%; tax revenue rose 6% to RMB16.262 trillion while non-tax revenue fell 0.2%.

body.zh: 据新浪财经，1—10月证券交易印花税2511亿元，同比增长54.1%。
body.en: Securities transaction stamp duty reached RMB251.1 billion, up 54.1%, according to [Sina Finance](https://finance.sina.com.cn/china/2026-11-20/doc-inizkqie3933082.shtml).
